lede: Second year mechanical engineering track student at the University of Maryland, on Terps Racing and Terps Rockets. I print, cut, build, and write down what went wrong. This site is my logbook: every project gets a number, every change gets a revision.
statement: Mechanical design first. Then wherever it leads: *motorsport*, *aerospace*, *space*, *autonomous vehicles*, and the *data* that tells you whether any of it worked.
heroImageAlt: A painted tiger drinking from a pond among lily pads, drawn as an animated mosaic of characters
